text: The quarterly Form PF reporting obligation imposed on hedge fund advisers with more than $1.5 billion in regulatory assets under management is designed to give the FSOC timely data for identifying systemic risk trends.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Barbara Luppi, Sandra Paterlini, Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Hedge Fund Performance (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2389416

isBasedOn.name: Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Hedge Fund Performance

abstract: The quarterly reporting requirement for large hedge fund advisers is intended to provide timely data that enables the FSOC to identify trends in systemic risk (IA Release 3308).

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: advisers with RAUM above $1.5 billion attributable to hedge funds
